label: Context
short: A written organisation brief a model can read, on a document ladder.
strong: The brief exists, is current, and staff start from it. Tell new staff where it is.

middle.3: Rung 3, out of date: one afternoon to refresh it.
middle.4: Rung 4, not linked from where staff start: one link, in the handbook or the drive root.

edge: The About page is a start. The brief adds tone, audiences and the things a tool must never claim. One afternoon.
unmet: Ask whether any file is handed to a tool before questions. If nobody knows, it does not exist.
